title: env-sync configuration
description: Project paths and rules used by the env-sync CLI.

$schema.description: Path or URI of this JSON Schema for editor integration.

template.description: Dotenv template path, relative to the configuration file.

target.description: Dotenv target path, relative to the configuration file.

allowed_extra_keys.description: Exact target-only keys that diff should accept.

allowed_extra_patterns.description: Case-sensitive whole-key globs accepted by diff; * matches any characters and ? matches one character.

required_changed_keys.description: Keys whose target values must differ from their template defaults.

conditional_requirements.description: Requirements activated when a target dotenv key has an exact value. Keys used by any branch are optional outside matching branches.

key.description: Target dotenv key selecting the branch.

equals.description: Exact non-secret selector value activating the branch.

required_keys.description: Keys required in the target while this branch is active.

required_changed_keys.description: Keys whose target values must differ from the template while this branch is active.
